{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")"}
